plan.insight: Softmax turns scores into probabilities; temperature sharpens or flattens them.
plan.user_changes: drag each logit up/down, temperature, random logits

components.title: Logits (drag)
components.onDrag: return { z: state.z.map((v, i) => i === index ? round(pos.y, 2) : v) };

components.title: Probabilities
components.draw:
const p = softmax(state.z, state.temp);
return [bars(p.map((v, i) => [i, v]), { color: 'blue', labels: ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'] }), ...p.map((v, i) => text(i, v, round(v, 2)))];
